title: Convert a Product URL to Video | AIVideosUGC
description: Paste a product link and get an AI video for ads, demos, and social posts. Approve the actor and the script, then download a file you can post.
h1: Make Video Ads From a Product URL
eyebrow: Paste a Link and Post the Clip
lead: Turn a product link into an AI video for ads, social posts, and product demos. You get that clip without a shoot and without the wait.
secondary_keywords: turn a link into a video
benefits_h2: Why Start the Video From the Product Link

benefits.t: Create the Video From the Product Page
benefits.d: The link pulls in the images and the product facts for you. There is no separate edit and no shoot before you have an ad you can post.
The draft is written from the product link, using the facts already on the page. Ask for the language you sell in, then fix any line before it runs.

benefits.t: Choose From 53 Realistic AI Actors for Your Ad
benefits.d: Pick from 53 AI actors so the ad can face the buyer you already sell to. The delivery stays steady from the first clip to the next.

benefits.t: Ads You Can Test Without a Shoot
benefits.d: Skip the crew and get more versions of the same product out faster. The time and the money stay in the ad, not in a studio day.

benefits.t: Choose Your Actor, Script, Voice, and Scene
benefits.d: Change the script, the voice, the actor, and the frame before you export. One product link can feed every placement you sell on.

steps_h2: How to Make a URL to Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: A public product page is the only link you need.

steps.d: Paste the public product page. The photo and the facts on it come into the project.
Pick an AI actor who fits the buyer, or stay with one you already saved for the shop.
Generate a script from your product page, edit any claim that needs work, then make the video.

faq.q: How do I go from the product link to a clip I can post?
faq.a: Paste the product link, choose your message and actor, then make the video. Download the ad in a few minutes.

faq.q: How do I turn a product listing into an ad I can run?
faq.a: Paste your product URL, choose a vertical or square size, and make the ad. Download it without a watermark for paid campaigns.

faq.q: Can I change the drafted script before the clip is made?
faq.a: Yes. Change the suggested script to match your product and offer before making the video. You can try another opening later.

faq.q: What do I get after I paste the product page?
faq.a: You get a suggested script, product visuals, and choices for actor and voice. Check the details before making the video.

faq.q: Why start from the listing instead of gathering the files myself?
faq.a: A product URL already holds your photos and details, so you can make an ad faster. There is no separate filming or file gathering.

faq.q: Which frames and lengths can I download?
faq.a: Download videos in 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds for your ad.

faq.q: Can I use the clip for ads, the product page, and social posts?
faq.a: Yes. Use the watermark-free video in paid ads, on product pages, or in social posts. Choose the size each placement needs.

faq.q: How long do I wait for the clip?
faq.a: A product-link video usually takes a few minutes. Start with a clear page, then choose the message and actor.

faq.q: How do I make a video from a product URL?
faq.a: Paste a public product link, choose an AI actor, and add your message. You can download the finished video in minutes.

faq.q: What kinds of product URLs can I use?
faq.a: Use public product pages with a clear image and details shoppers can see. Private pages need a product photo upload instead.

faq.q: How many credits does a product-link video use?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits; 10, 15, and 30 seconds use 40, 60, and 120. Failed jobs return credits.

faq.q: Do I need editing experience for the first clip?
faq.a: No. Paste your link, choose an actor and message, and make the video. You can create it without editing software.

faq.q: What clips can I post from one product link?
faq.a: Make product demos, listing videos, social posts, and paid ads from one product link. Try different messages without another shoot.

cta_lead: Paste a public product page. You see the credit cost before the clip starts.

uses.d: Turn the product page into a video that shows one feature and the price already listed there. The clip uses that page's photo.
Show one use of the product with an AI actor. You do not film it, and the clip can sit on the product page.
The ad is built from the link you already send shoppers to. Captions are in the file, so the line stays on screen while it plays.
Make a tall clip for Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok from the same link. The product stays large on the phone.

definition.title: What Is a URL to Video
paras: You paste a public product page. The photo and the facts on it come in, and a script, an actor, and a voice are drafted for you to approve.
You can edit the script, the captions, and the music before you download. The person on screen is an AI actor. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

reasons.h2: Why Your Product URL Makes Video Ads Faster
reasons.lead: Paste the link. The hours of writing, editing, and shooting do not have to happen first.

items.t: Make Your Video Ad in Minutes
items.d: Paste the link and the video starts from that page. You do not write a script from scratch or book an edit before the first draft.
The script and the video come back from the link. You drop the URL in and approve the result, instead of building each piece by hand.

items.t: Make Videos From Several Product Links at Once
items.d: Make a clip for several product links in minutes. A launch, a demo, and a social post do not each need their own shoot.

items.t: Use Reviews Already on Your Product Page
items.d: If the page already has a shopper note, the clip can say it. You do not hunt for that line or type it into a new brief.

benefits_lead: Paste the page once. The draft script, the pictures, and a voice come back, and you approve them before the clip runs.

reviews.h2: How Sellers Start From a Product Link
reviews.lead: Four sellers paste a public product page and post the clip that comes back.

items.d: They paste the public yoga-mat page and get a listing clip that uses that page's photo of the rolled mat. They skip gathering files into a folder first.
They paste the sage-green lunch box page and have an actor open the latch once so a buyer sees the seal. They put that demo on the product page and skip filming a kitchen.
They paste the face-cream page, approve the spoken line, and run the file as a paid ad. Captions sit in the clip, and they skip a studio for that jar.
They paste the cold-brew page and make a tall clip of a pour for a phone feed. They approve the script first and skip a cafe shoot.

trust.h2: More Versions From One Product Link
trust.lead: One public page can feed more than the single clip you export today.

items.d: Keep the same product page and swap the AI actor when you want a second opening for the test.
Start from a template that already has a place for the product. Pick the voice that reads the line. You are not booking a booth.
The product does not change. The spoken line can use the other language already written on that page.
